title: Qwen Image: text to image (4-step Lightning)
summary: GGUF-quantized Qwen Image with a Lightning LoRA for fast 4-step results and an optional prompt enhancer.

steps.title: A quantized model (GGUF)
steps.body: This loads qwen-image-2512 as a GGUF file at Q6_K. GGUF files are compressed ('quantized') versions of a model: smaller in VRAM, with a small quality trade-off that depends on the quantization level.
steps.tryIt: Don't change it yet. Larger Q numbers are closer to the original but need more memory.
source: docs/reports/track_facts.md: Gen Image with Qwen and Prompt Enhancer.json

steps.title: The Lightning LoRA
steps.body: A LoRA is a small add-on that changes a model's behavior. The file here is named Lightning-4steps: it is what lets this workflow produce a good image in 4 steps instead of the usual dozens. Strength 1 applies it fully.
steps.tryIt: Bypass this node and Queue to see how many steps you would otherwise need.
source: docs/reports/track_facts.md: Gen Image with Qwen and Prompt Enhancer.json

steps.title: The text encoder
steps.body: Qwen 2.5 VL (7B, FP8) reads your prompt. The 'type' is qwen_image so ComfyUI wires it correctly for this model family.
source: docs/reports/track_facts.md: Gen Image with Qwen and Prompt Enhancer.json

steps.title: The VAE
steps.body: qwen_image_vae turns the finished latent into pixels. Use the VAE that matches the model.
source: docs/reports/track_facts.md: Gen Image with Qwen and Prompt Enhancer.json

steps.title: Your idea
steps.body: The short prompt you write. When the enhancer is on, it is rewritten before reaching the model.
source: docs/reports/track_facts.md: Gen Image with Qwen and Prompt Enhancer.json

steps.title: The prompt rewriter
steps.body: Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct expands your short prompt in the Refine style.
source: docs/reports/track_facts.md: Gen Image with Qwen and Prompt Enhancer.json

steps.title: Enhancer on/off
steps.body: True sends the rewritten prompt on; false sends your text untouched.
steps.tryIt: Toggle it and compare two runs.
source: docs/reports/track_facts.md: Gen Image with Qwen and Prompt Enhancer.json

steps.title: Negative prompt
steps.body: Describes what to steer away from. In this workflow it is a Chinese list that roughly means: low resolution, low quality, deformed limbs, deformed fingers, oversaturated, waxy look, faces with no detail, over-smooth, an AI look, chaotic composition, blurred or distorted text. Qwen models understand Chinese, so a Chinese list works.
steps.tryIt: Edit it and see what changes.
source: docs/reports/track_facts.md: Gen Image with Qwen and Prompt Enhancer.json

steps.title: The canvas
steps.body: A blank latent at 1024 by 1024. Generation starts from noise at this size.
source: docs/reports/track_facts.md: Gen Image with Qwen and Prompt Enhancer.json

steps.title: The sampler
steps.body: 4 steps, cfg 1, euler, simple scheduler, denoise 1. These low numbers go together with the Lightning LoRA: without it you would normally need more steps and a higher cfg.
steps.tryIt: Raise steps to 20 and cfg to 4 with the LoRA on and see whether it helps or hurts.
source: docs/reports/track_facts.md: Gen Image with Qwen and Prompt Enhancer.json

steps.title: Latent to pixels
steps.body: Decodes the result into a visible image.
steps.tryIt: Follow the wire back to the VAE loader.
source: docs/reports/track_facts.md: Gen Image with Qwen and Prompt Enhancer.json

steps.title: Your result
steps.body: Previews and saves the image with the workflow embedded.
steps.tryIt: Queue and compare with the Flux2 lesson.
source: docs/reports/track_facts.md: Gen Image with Qwen and Prompt Enhancer.json

steps.title: Run it
steps.body: Queue Prompt sends the whole workflow to the GPU. Nodes light up as they run, and results appear in the Save node.
steps.tryIt: Press Ctrl+Enter, or the Queue button in the highlighted area.
